title: Unique to One Place
text: Some species have a worldwide distribution (like rats or cockroaches). Others are found only in very specific locations. If a species lives only in one place on Earth, it has a special name.

title: Endemic Means Native Only There
text: Endemic comes from Greek 'endemos' meaning 'native'. An endemic species is native to and restricted to a particular area. If its habitat is destroyed, the species will go extinct because it exists nowhere else.
